$phase_004_comunas_2026_07_28.built: Screen rebuilt from screen/_official_layout/css/comunas.css + view.comunas.js as modular parts under templates/parts/cmn/: styles, data, hero, card, layout. /comunas is now a mount point on the Blank Canvas Apollo+ shell, matching phases 001-003.
$phase_004_comunas_2026_07_28.data_layer: apollo-groups stores groups in its OWN tables ({prefix}apollo_groups + apollo_group_members), NOT a CPT — so the provider reads SQL directly rather than WP_Query. New apollo_cmn_list() returns public comunas with live membership counts and the viewer's own role, guarded by a SHOW TABLES check so a fresh install returns [] instead of fataling. The mockup's APOLLO_COMUNAS fixture global is NOT ported; only its shape is honoured.
$phase_004_comunas_2026_07_28.bug_double_document: First deploy rendered a BLANK page. Cause: handle_virtual_pages() routes every group template through render_blank_canvas(), which opens a document itself — so an Apollo+ screen calling apollo_plus_open() emitted TWO <head>/<body> pairs. Fixed with an explicit apollo_plus_screens allow-list that includes the template directly; every other group screen keeps the legacy wrapper untouched. THIS TRAP APPLIES TO EVERY REMAINING PHASE: any plugin whose router pre-opens a document must be bypassed the same way (apollo-adverts already did this correctly via include+exit).
$phase_004_comunas_2026_07_28.strict_tokens: comunas.css ported verbatim; every token probed against a live Apollo page first. All resolve except --fs-body-sm and --fs-caption, rewritten to core.js's --fs-u at port time. No token declared, no :root block.
$phase_004_comunas_2026_07_28.verified: Rendered in-browser (cache-busted, logged-in): Apollo+ aside with Comuna highlighted, hero with real zero-counts, search, honest empty state ('Nenhuma comuna criada ainda') and the create CTA. 0 comunas exist in the DB, so the empty state is correct — the populated path is unproven until a comuna is created.
